mapper.select: select id, customer_service_image_key, customer_service_tip, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from wl_vip_page_config where id = 1 and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update wl_vip_page_config set customer_service_image_key = #{config.customerServiceImageKey}, customer_service_tip = #{config.customerServiceTip}, update_by = #{config.updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = 1 and del_flag = '0' and (customer_service_image_key = #{expectedImageKey} or (customer_service_image_key is null and #{expectedImageKey} is null))
